title: rewardRate derived from total minted NFT supply but divided by totalStaked allows a lone staker to capture full T-derived emissions at unbounded effective APY
asset_impact: Reward budget is drained far faster than the advertised targetAPY implies when participation is low. Over-emission relative to APY target; late or non-participating NFT holders see runway exhausted before they can stake.
attack_path:
1. Protocol configures targetAPY at MAX=50% against N=100 minted NFTs.
2. Sophisticated actor mints 1 NFT and stakes it alone while totalStaked is tiny (e.g. 1).
3. rewardRate is computed against the full T (all 100 NFTs' notional value) but accRewardPerShare is divided by totalStaked=1 — lone staker captures 100% of the T-derived reward rate.
4. Effective APY on that 1 NFT = targetAPY * (N / totalStaked), unbounded for small totalStaked. Budget depletes ~N times faster than documented.
likelihood: medium - requires low participation. Realistic at launch and during low-TVL periods; sophisticated actors can deliberately stake early and alone.
assumptions: targetAPY is non-zero and totalStaked is small relative to N. No upper cap on individual APY is documented.
justification: Budget drains faster than advertised APY suggests; protocol function (runway predictability) impacted; profit path exists for early lone stakers but not a direct theft — they staked legitimately. Value leak with stated assumptions (low participation). C4 Medium.
